teaser.en: Cooks pick *mnavu* by the look and the taste of its leaves, which carry a gentle bitterness that coconut milk softens.
teaser.sw: Wapishi huchagua *mnavu* kwa kuangalia sura na ladha ya majani yake, ambayo yana uchungu kidogo unaolainishwa na tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Ajiti nkutsambula *mnavu* kpwa kulola sura na ladha ya makodzage, ambago gana utsungu chidide unaophunguzwa ni huwi.

summary.en: *Mnavu* is African nightshade, a garden herb with small white flowers and black berries. Its slightly bitter leaves are boiled as a vegetable, often with coconut.
summary.sw: *Mnavu* ni mnavu, mmea mdogo wa bustanini wenye maua madogo meupe na matunda madogo meusi. Majani yake yenye uchungu kidogo huchemshwa kama mboga, mara nyingi kwa nazi.
summary.dg: *Mnavu* (kpwa Chingereza *African nightshade*) ni mmea wa busitani wenye maruwa madide mereru na matunda maru. Makodzage gana utsungu chidide na nkuokohwa dza mboga, mara nyinji na nazi.

about.en:
*Mnavu* is a soft, branching herb with oval, dark green leaves. Its small white flowers have a yellow centre, like tiny tomato flowers, and they are followed by clusters of small round berries that ripen black or purple-black.

Several closely related nightshades share the name, and people tell them apart by the look and the taste of the leaves.
about.sw:
*Mnavu* ni mmea laini wenye matawi mengi, wenye majani yenye umbo la yai ya kijani kilichokolea. Maua yake madogo meupe yana kiini cha manjano, kama maua madogo ya nyanya, na baada yake huja vishada vya matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva kuwa meusi au zambarau-nyeusi.

Mimea kadhaa ya jamii ya karibu sana hushiriki jina hili, na watu huitofautisha kwa sura na ladha ya majani.
about.dg:
*Mnavu* ni mmea laini wenye panda nyinji, na makodza ga chijani sana ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura. Maruwage madide mereru gana kahi-kahi ya rangi ya mandano, dza maruwa madide sana ga nyanya, na bada yao kunatuluka makundi ga matunda madide ga mviringo, ganayoivwa gakakala maru au zambarau-nyiru.

Mimea minji ya aina za phephi-phephi inaihwa kpwa dzina hiri, na atu nkuitafwautisha kpwa kulola sura na ladha ya makodza.

where.en: It comes up by itself in gardens, often where the soil is rich, and is left to grow for its leaves.
where.sw: Huota wenyewe bustanini, mara nyingi pale udongo una rutuba, na huachwa ukue kwa ajili ya majani yake.
where.dg: Unamera macheye busitani, mara nyinji phatu phenye mtsanga wa mbolea, na nkurichwa ukule kpwa sababu ya makodzage.

uses.en: The leaves are boiled as a vegetable. They are slightly bitter and are often cooked with coconut.
uses.sw: Majani huchemshwa kama mboga. Yana uchungu kidogo na mara nyingi hupikwa kwa nazi.
uses.dg: Makodzage nkuokohwa dza mboga. Gana utsungu chidide, na mara nyinji nkujitwa na nazi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mnavu*, the same as in Swahili, Duruma and Giriama. In English it is African nightshade or black nightshade. Scientifically it belongs to a group of closely related species around *Solanum nigrum* and *S. scabrum*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mnavu*, sawa na la Kiswahili, Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African nightshade* au *black nightshade*. Kisayansi ni wa kundi la spishi za karibu sana zinazozunguka *Solanum nigrum* na *S. scabrum*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mnavu*, sawa na Chiswahili, Chiduruma na Chigiryama. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African nightshade* au *black nightshade*. Kpwa sayansi ni wa kundi ra aina za phephi-phephi kanda-kanda ya *Solanum nigrum* na *S. scabrum*.

reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya kila siku
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza ya chila siku.

reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani yenye uchungu
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza yenye utsungu.
